campaign_logline: In a fractured orbital landscape, you are a courier of secrets, navigating the friction between corporations and cartels for survival.
campaign_pitch: A gritty, low-stakes trade simulation evolving into high-stakes shadow diplomacy. Experience an economy driven by scrap metal, clandestine corporate treaties, hidden routes, and the desperate negotiations of a haunted merchant legend.
campaign_story_summary: The system is in decay. Corporate giants Zenith and Vanguard have stalled on mining rights, while Aurelia’s inner circles engage in secret pacts. You are a pilot navigating this deadlock, hauling high-value components between warring factions who don't know they are cooperating behind the scenes. Your primary contact, Kaelen, a ghost of old trade routes, guides you through the scrap-economy hurdles, while you decide which powers to feed and which to starve.

opening.status_quo: The orbital sector is a wasteland of industrial decay where resources are traded in bits of scrap and reclaimed tech.
opening.visible_crisis: A severe shortage of high-value minerals and the collapse of formal trade routes due to 'scarcity' wars between Zenith and Vanguard.
opening.hidden_crisis: Secret cooperation agreements exist between major factions, orchestrated by shadow players who profit from maintaining a state of perpetual conflict.
opening.why_now: A massive fluctuation in scrap market prices is signaling the collapse of the secret middle-men managers.

harmony_1.title: Broken Bonds
harmony_1.goal: Establish local reputation and secure first shipment of core components.
harmony_1.opening_incident: The Reaver ship suffers a critical mechanical failure during a routine haul, forcing an immediate redirection to a nearby scrap yard.
harmony_1.midpoint_turn: You discover that the 'smuggling' route you were using is actually a secret supply line for Aurelia’s inner circle.
harmony_1.finale: A choice must be made: report the smuggling line or sabotage the surveillance of both Zenith and Vanguard to keep it open.
harmony_1.player_takeaway: The player learns that navigation involves political consequences as much as physical risk.

starter_mission.title: The Reaver’s Fault
starter_mission.reason: To introduce the mechanics of cargo management and mechanical failure impact.
starter_mission.enemy_identity: Patrol drones from a local scrap scavenger crew.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: They are unaware that you possess high-value tech for their own internal disputes.
starter_mission.after_effect: Establishing a foothold in the scrap community.

recurring_clue.name: The Ghost of the Scrap Trail
recurring_clue.signal: A recurring pattern of encrypted data packets on local trade frequencies.
recurring_clue.first_appearance: Briefly heard as static-laced warnings during a routine hop between Vanguard zones.
recurring_clue.escalation: The packets become more frequent and specific to your route, providing 'safe' bypass codes for corporate security patrols.
recurring_clue.payoff_hint: Hints at the existence of an underground network managing the shadow economy.

rumor_trail.name: Whispers of the Core
clue_templates: A merchant's frantic note regarding 'The Hollow Corridor'.
Encrypted telemetry for a bypass route to the Aurelia interior.
rumor_trail.payoff: Access to a hidden supply line connecting all three major trade hubs.

horizon.gate_tease: The revelation of the 'Shadow Manager' who coordinates between Zenith and Aurelia.
horizon.new_system_reveal_rule: New systems are revealed as your reputation with both Zenith and Vanguard increases beyond a threshold.
horizon.future_pressure_tease: As scrap prices fluctuate, trade routes will become more restricted, forcing you to take higher-risk paths.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tease: Rarely mined minerals and high-tech components are revealed as the player builds a reputation with Aurelia's inner circle.

regeneration_trigger.description: When no active rumor trails are available, generate a new one based on the shadow economy's growing influence.

rules.humor__rule: Keep it grounded and gritty; avoid overly dramatic dialogue for pilots who have been in the space-scavenger trenches.
rules.fallback: If a mission objective is missing, use the logic of 'economic consequence' instead of quest markers.
banned_repeats: Unless you are told otherwise, never mention it as a joke.

story_questions_for_future_generation: How will player choice affect the future availability of harder-based minerals?
Which routes become available as the player's reputation grows?
Who are the new hidden power players emerging in shards of debris?
Why is the market price for scrap metal fluctuating during the conflict?
What consequences do they face if they fail a high-risk delivery?
